features.name: Lower Macleay Trailhead
features.description: Lower Macleay is a popular transit-accessible start along Balch Creek with a larger parking area, ADA spaces, bike racks, and the route toward Stone House.

details.positionQuality: Lower Macleay Park Trailhead, Lower Macleay Trail, Willamette Heights, Forest Park, Portland, Multnomah County, Oregon, 97210, United States
details.imageAlt: Lower Macleay Trailhead at Forest Park

features.name: Stone House
features.description: Stone House, often called Witch's Castle, is a roofless historic structure along Lower Macleay Trail; it is a trail landmark, not a staffed building or restroom.

details.positionQuality: Witch's Castle, Wildwood Trail, Forest Park, Portland, Multnomah County, Oregon, 97210, United States

features.name: Wildwood Trail
features.description: The 30-mile natural-surface Wildwood Trail runs the length of Forest Park; use blue diamond markers, carry a map, and check closures before choosing a segment.

details.positionQuality: Wildwood Trail, Forest Park, Portland, Multnomah County, Oregon, 97210, United States

features.name: Leif Erikson Drive Trailhead
features.description: Leif Erikson Drive is a broad gravel multi-use route popular with runners and cyclists; the Thurman trailhead has very limited parking and bike racks.

features.name: Pittock Mansion Trailhead
features.description: The Wildwood/Pittock trailhead connects forest hiking with Pittock Mansion; parking is larger than many trailheads but the mansion and grounds keep separate rules.

features.name: Germantown Road Trailhead
features.description: Germantown Road accesses northern Wildwood and Leif Erikson routes; use the exact official lot because traffic and road shoulders make informal arrival unsafe.
